method: two Claude Code workflow agents per ~80 s range read 2-fps contact sheets (intent/workflows/condensed_scan.js); detections paired by release time (<= 1.5 s) and matched in feed order by half, inning, batter surname and count; ties broken by the post-pitch type/speed graphic, then by the outcome; no-scoreboard detections, unresolved ties and graphic conflicts are left out unless an operator decision (with reason) assigns them (python -m intent.condensed map)

operator_decisions.reason: Only reader A listed it. The bug read count 0-1 and Sale P:43, i.e. after pitch 21:1 (Sale had thrown 42 before 21:1). The feed has no second pitch in PA21; it ended on 'Pickoff Caught Stealing 2B' after a pickoff attempt to first, which matches the reader's description of a throw to first and a runner out at second. The delivery seen is the pickoff move.
Both readers read count 1-2 and Luzardo P:65. 37:4 and 37:5 are both 1-2 sweepers at 86.1/85.8 mph, so the graphic cannot separate them; Luzardo had thrown 65 pitches before 37:5 and 64 before 37:4.

The count-based match 42:3 is confirmed: both readers read 1-1 and Sale P:76, and Sale had thrown 76 pitches before 42:3; the readers' single to right matches 'In play, no out'. The conflict is only the type label: the broadcast graphic said FOUR SEAM 97 where Statcast typed the pitch SI 96.8 mph.
